title: A Camping Trip
description: Three short recordings about a camping trip: a conversation at home, a talk at the campsite and a night-time chat.
instructions: Read the questions for each part first. Then press Play and listen. Choose the best answer (A, B or C) for each question.

parts.title: Part 1 · Getting ready
parts.intro: You will hear Tom and his mum talking about a camping trip.

script.speaker: Mum
script.text: Tom, are you ready for the camping trip? We leave at nine o'clock tomorrow.

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: Nearly, Mum. I've packed my sleeping bag and my torch. Do I need a raincoat?

script.speaker: Mum
script.text: Yes, the weather forecast says rain on Saturday. Take warm socks too, it's cold at night. Please put your things by the front door tonight, so we don't forget anything in the morning.

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: Where are we going to camp?

script.speaker: Mum
script.text: By the lake in the forest, near Grandpa's farm. Dad and Uncle Sam will meet us there.

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: Brilliant! Can I bring my guitar?

script.speaker: Mum
script.text: No, sorry, there isn't enough space in the car.

parts.title: Part 2 · At the campsite
parts.intro: You will hear Mr Park, the campsite guide, talking to the campers.

script.speaker: Mr Park
script.text: Welcome to Green Lake campsite, everyone. Please listen carefully before you put up your tents.

script.speaker: Mr Park
script.text: Put your tents in the field, not under the trees. Dinner is at six o'clock in the big tent.

script.speaker: Mr Park
script.text: You can swim in the lake, but only with an adult. Never go in alone.

script.speaker: Mr Park
script.text: Tonight we'll make a fire at eight o'clock and sing songs. Tomorrow, we'll go for a walk to the waterfall.

script.speaker: Mr Park
script.text: The toilets are behind the shop. If you have a problem, come and find me. I'm in the red tent. Thank you for listening, and I hope you all have a lovely stay at the campsite.

parts.title: Part 3 · A night-time noise
parts.intro: You will hear Tom and his cousin Lily at night.

script.speaker: Lily
script.text: Tom, I can't sleep. I heard a strange noise outside.

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: It's probably an owl, Lily. Look, I'll shine my torch.

script.speaker: Lily
script.text: Oh! Two big eyes in the tree. You're right, it's an owl!

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: Don't be scared. Owls are nice. Shall we have a hot chocolate? Dad is making some on the fire.

script.speaker: Lily
script.text: Yes, please. And I want to look at the stars. The sky is so clear tonight. Tomorrow we can find the owl's tree again if you want, and take some photos.
